clue.text: Tribal symbol, as those people see it, is short of height

clue.text: Dog often turning up, interrupting my redesign

clue.text: Bottom, giving no thought to one's performance?

clue.text: Try Polanski film including line without mercy

clue.text: Regulated online talk provider bringing in a Parisian

a in French is un

clue.text: Succeed or break?

clue.text: Old story: talk of translated article by Proust

Proust wrote in French, where le is the definite article

clue.text: Wild hairstyle, with length trimmed, producing emotional outburst

clue.text: Perhaps quarrelsome craftsman flourished alongside engraver

clue.text: Charge adolescent producing mess

taken as written

clue.text: Twain hero, beset by drink, is to give in

taken as written

the last letter of this word
